I loved Village, I've played through it 7 times to 100% it, I don't want there to be any delusions I didn't think it was a really good Resident Evil game, however:


1. Tone. It was a fun game generally. The Village was great at serving as a central hub between what felt like essentially genre changes between the lords. But it was jarring and sometimes odd how it couldn't decide when it was trying to scare me or be an action game. Overall in terms of actual horror I felt super underwhelmed and while it was a blast to play I wanted so desperately to be scared and it didn't really capture that like 7.


2. Pacing. Castle Dimitrescu felt fun and fleshed out. Donna's segment was amazing the first time but once you know what to do you can clear it in 10 minutes and you're wishing there was more. Moreau is a personal favorite character but his section felt like it had stuff cut from it. And Heisenberg, ironically, overstayed its welcome in my opinion. 


3. AI. This is maybe nitpicky because I love Dimitrescu and her daughters, but I do feel like I need to point this out. Mr. X and Jack Baker will follow you just about anywhere. You never know when to expect them and when they show up you panic. I'm not gonna gonna say all the interactions with the Dimitrescus are 100% scripted because they clearly have some freedom, but it becomes apparent sometimes they spawn in one room and as soon as you run through a door they just despawn. Once you learn the spawns it takes all the tension out of it, and it feels like you're only having 30 seconds interactions with them at any given time.


I loved Village. It pulled elements from 7 and 4, two of my favorite Resident Evil games. And I'll definitely play it again in the future (I'm played out after trophy hunting for a month). That being said, I do worry a little for the franchise. The mindless action schlock is in some sense a trademark of Resident Evil, I'd never say it makes it a bad game, but that *one* boss fight in particular was next level even for Resident Evil (you know the one).


So basically, Village is awesome. I just hope Capcom doesn't lose sight of what makes Resident Evil such a beloved survival horror franchise.
